title: Exam preparation
text: Most actuarial pathways start with a handful of exams on probability, financial mathematics and statistics. Our study groups meet weekly, and past members share their study plans in the Discord.

links.label: Society of Actuaries: exams and requirements

title: Study materials
text: Our shared drive has practice problem sets, formula sheets and worked solutions contributed by members. Request access with your school email.

title: Careers and resumes
text: Not sure how to get your first internship? Start with our resume template and the list of companies that recruit on campus each year.

title: Software and skills
text: Pricing and reserving work happens in Excel, R and Python. Our workshops cover the basics.
